name: foreach-audit
description: Batch audit: run the foreach-item template once per target, collect per-item results, and fail the run when any target did not pass (builtin-only, zero external dependencies)

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Regular expression applied to every target

inputs.name: targets
inputs.description: List of {target, min_matches} entries, one per audited file

params.message: one or more targets failed; per-item details in ${nodes.loop.outputs.results_file}
